### Bible Pathways 02/08/2003
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-08-or-2003-1184770.html
Passage: Leviticus 21:1-14
Points:
- Priests were required to represent the Lord continually, maintaining holiness in their personal conduct, mourning customs, and family relationships.
- God established strict boundaries regarding marriage and defilement so that His holy name and sanctuary would never be profaned.
- Because spiritual leaders exert wide influence over God's people, they are held to a higher standard of accountability.
- As believers made into a kingdom of priests through Christ, Christians are called to set a godly example in daily life.
